title: Ordinary exchange on an affine-open pushforward
statement: Let A,B be commutative rings, f:X→Spec A a separated morphism, g:Spec B→Spec A, G a quasi-coherent module on X, and W an affine open of X. With the canonical pullback square of f and g, the ordinary module base change map [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-open-restriction] on W.ι_*(G restricted to W) is an isomorphism. No complex, derived category, product, or localization appears.

proof.text: Write j=W.ι, p=pullback.fst f g, and f'=pullback.snd f g. Form the canonical pullback square sj for j along p, and paste it vertically with the canonical square sf for f along g. The affine-open hypothesis gives IsAffine W. Since W and Spec A are affine, j≫f is affine. IsAffineHom.of_comp j f and separatedness of f make j affine. Restriction preserves quasi-coherence by Mathlib Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_restrictFunctor.

Apply affinePushforward_baseChange_isIso to G|W in sj and in sj.paste_vert sf. Only the isomorphism clause is needed; the quasi-coherence-of-pushforward, algebra, and horizontal-composition clauses of the larger affine base-change module are unused.

The proved private exchange_unit lemma is the defining adjunction equation. To prove the private exchange_vertical identity, apply injectivity of the g adjunction Hom equivalence. Its left and right naturality formulas and exchange_unit identify both adjoints. Naturality of the canonical pushforward square moves exchange for j past that square; exchange_unit for j then replaces it by pushforward of the q unit. On sections the remaining equality is functoriality of the restriction maps between equal opens, with equality of their arrows by thinness. Thus tensorPullback g of the pushforward-composition isomorphism followed by outer exchange equals exchange for f on j_*G|W followed by f'_* of exchange for j and the target pushforward-composition isomorphism. The left side is invertible. The two factors after exchange for f are invertible, so isIso_comp_right_iff cancels them.

lean.statement:
theorem affineOpen_pushforward_exchange
    {A B : CommRingCat.{u}} {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec A)
    [IsSeparated f] (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec A)
    (G : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.{u} G]
    (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) :
    IsIso (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
      (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward W.ι).obj (G.restrict W.ι)))
